response.text:
I can do that — before I add it, please confirm the exact details so I schedule the right time and send invites.

Please confirm each of the items below:

1. Which Tuesday? (e.g., "this Tuesday, Sep 8" or provide the date)
2. Does "4" mean 4:00 PM Singapore time (SGT) or 4:00 PM Chicago time (Central Time)? (I need the local timezone reference to convert correctly.)
3. External auditor: full name and email address to invite.
4. Which calendar/organizer email should I use to create the event?
5. Meeting title and any agenda/description to include (optional).
6. Add a video link? (Google Meet / Zoom / Teams / none)
7. Reminders (e.g., 15 minutes before) and whether to send the calendar invite now.
8. Is this a one-off meeting? (scope: one) — I assume yes unless you want a recurring series.

Once you confirm those, I’ll create the 30‑minute event and send the invite.
